_meta.purpose: Canonical buzzword ban list shared by deslop-tech-comms and thermo-nuclear-writing-review. Both SKILL.md files must derive their ban tables from this source. The check.sh diff guards against drift.
_meta.carveout_rule: Only ban these terms when no specific behavior is named alongside them. 'Robust red-teaming process with adversarial probes from 5 internal teams' is legitimate; 'we built a robust solution' is buzzword. Fire on the latter, pass the former.
_meta.brand_voice_override: If a context/brand-voice.md or project CLAUDE.md voice section is in scope, suspend this ban table for marketing landing pages, sales copy, and advertising surfaces.
